description: Turn a date written in natural language or local numeric formats into an ISO date/datetime: '3 mars 2026', '12.11.2026', 'next month', 'غداً', 'in 3 weeks', and Hijri dates such as '15 رمضان 1447' or '1 Muharram 1448' (converted by Umm al-Qura). Returns precision (day/month/year/time), the detected language and the relative base used. Pass languages and date_order when known. Example: text '١٥ رمضان ١٤٤٧'. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[]; deterministic (no AI inside), nothing logged.

date_order.description: Order for ambiguous numeric dates. Pass it whenever you know the source country.
date_order.title: Date Order

languages.description: Language codes to try, e.g. ['en','ar','fr']. Strongly recommended for speed and accuracy.
languages.title: Languages

prefer_future.description: Resolve ambiguous relative dates forward (deadlines) rather than backward.
prefer_future.title: Prefer Future

relative_base.description: ISO datetime that relative phrases ('tomorrow', 'in 3 days') count from. Default: now.
relative_base.title: Relative Base

text.description: A date as humans write it: '3 mars 2026', '12/11/2026', 'غداً', 'in 3 weeks', '15 رمضان 1447', '2026-11-12T10:00'.
text.title: Text

timezone.description: IANA zone for the result, e.g. 'Asia/Dubai'.
timezone.title: Timezone

name: parse_date
title: Parse a human-written date (200 locales + Hijri)
